Firmware.TimeDetails:
Measured full transfers took about 45–50 minutes. Allow at least 1 hour; verification, restarts, and retries may take longer.

Windows testing used an ATT MTU of 100 and safe data blocks of about 45 bytes, waiting sequentially for each GATT write response and GAIA ACK. This adds acknowledgment overhead. The official Android app may use a larger MTU, different connection parameters, and RWCP streaming to reduce waiting and improve throughput.

Keep your speaker charged and near your computer. Do not close the app, disconnect power, or let the computer sleep.
